name: @azohra/meteo.j2k
description: A pure-TypeScript ITU-T T.800 JPEG 2000 decoder scoped to the codestream subset ECCC's GRIB2 feeds ship: single tile, single grayscale component, reversible 5/3 wavelet, single quality layer, default precincts, MQ-coded EBCOT. Anything outside that subset throws a named UnsupportedJ2kError. Validated bit-for-bit against the OpenJPEG oracles over the golden fixture corpus.
author: Justin Watts
